test_results.observation: A successful handler and application-layer terminal disposition recorded exactly one processed outcome with the approved queue/job labels.
The retry outcome remained absent before publisher confirmation and was recorded exactly once after confirmed retry publication and disposition.
Retry publication failure recorded one failed outcome, no retry success, and no dead-letter reason; routing failure logs included attempt and retry_publish stage.
Confirmed terminal DLQ handoff recorded failed plus retry_exhausted, and malformed input recorded failed plus poison while mapping poison to OTHER job_type.
Failed terminal DLQ publication recorded one failed outcome and no dead-letter event or reason.
AMQP transport correlation precedence won a deliberate mismatch and the canonical value remained equal across retry/DLQ carriers.
Queue metric labels stayed within the approved names/unions and injected metrics observation failures did not change business processing or disposition.
Alert YAML parsed, zero-event stayed inactive, poison/retry_exhausted events fired, replicas aggregated, and runbook boundaries remained intact.

approval_evidence: User explicitly approved using Node 24 for this acceptance run.
